mechanism.name: Pointwise conditional mean in the Shang–Cheng smoothing-spline design

generation_equations.label: 2. Regression function
generation_equations.expression: B_(a,b)(z)=Gamma(a+b)/(Gamma(a)*Gamma(b))*z^(a-1)*(1-z)^(b-1); g0(z)=0.6*B_(30,17)(z)+0.4*B_(3,11)(z). Deterministic source Beta densities; all declared shapes exceed 1, so both endpoint limits are 0.

generation_equations.label: 3. Gaussian error
generation_equations.expression: epsilon_i iid N(0,0.05^2), independent of Z. Noise sd=0.05; variance=0.0025.

generation_equations.label: 4. Observed response
generation_equations.expression: Y_i=g0(Z_i)+epsilon_i; return Z,Y. No additional noise or oracle column. Both z0=.5 and .64 are contribution query choices.

sampling.dependence: iid across pairs; within a pair, Y depends on Z through g0(Z)

assumptions: Observed pairs (Z,Y) are independent and identically distributed across sampling units
Z is Uniform(0,1) and the Gaussian regression error is independent of Z
The declared two-component Beta-density mixture is the conditional mean function
The query point is fixed in the interior of [0,1]; machine checks do not establish smoothing-spline confidence-interval or simultaneous-band coverage

properties.notes: The only covariate Z is active. Nonlinearity is the bimodal mixture g0(z)=0.6 beta_30,17(z)+0.4 beta_3,11(z); there are no covariate interactions.

estimand.name: g0(z0) = E[Y | Z = z0]
estimand.definition: The scalar conditional mean at the scenario's fixed query point z0. This is a pointwise target, not a simultaneous confidence-band target.

truth.expression: The scalar conditional mean at the scenario's fixed query point z0. This is a pointwise target, not a simultaneous confidence-band target.
truth.derivation: Closed-form evaluation of the two Beta densities using math.lgamma at the fixed query point.

adaptations: Keep the Case (I) Gaussian regression DGP and its Beta mixture unchanged.
Replace interval/curve-level inference by scalar g0(z0); both z0=0.5 and z0=0.64 are contribution choices. A 30-point evaluation grid does not establish an original fixed query at 0.5.
Use the requested n and CPU checks; do not fit periodic splines or assess coverage.
